BiblicalUsage: 1) to lure, entice, snare, lay a snare or lure, set a trap; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lay snares (fig. of devices of wicked); 1a2) fowlers (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be ensnared, be caught by a bait; 1c) (Pual) to be entrapped
